value.name: virtual-bash
value.description: Extensible virtual shell with pluggable filesystems and streaming commands

exclusions: Only the declared tests/**/*.test.ts discovery rule excludes direct execution. All committed files remain in the archive; matching stress tests and characterizations are not removed. Nonmatching helpers/child cases may still be imported or invoked by matching tests.
safejs: SAFEJS_LOCAL_ROOT stays unset. Existing unavailable-engine skips remain non-acceptance; ef1699b real-engine public acceptance is separate.
authorization: Inspection does not authorize execution. Full run requires an explicit root integration handoff and --handoff full commit hash --execute.
